traceability.notes: The story 024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS is fully implemented. `normalizeCommentLine` centrally strips backtick-wrapped content with a length-preserving replacement (REQ-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE, REQ-PRESERVE-BOUNDARIES, REQ-CENTRALIZED-FILTER). Unit tests in `tests/rules/valid-annotation-format-internal.test.ts` exercise the required scenarios: ignoring inline-code `@story`/`@req`, handling documentation patterns like `` `@story` + `@req` ``, correctly preserving and detecting real annotations that appear outside backticks, handling multiple backtick segments, and preserving behavior on lines without backticks. All Jest tests, including these, pass in the latest run, satisfying the no-regression criterion. The behavior is also clearly documented in the JSDoc for `normalizeCommentLine`. Therefore all acceptance criteria for this story are met.
